title: fix(platform-objects): the settings audit old_hash / new_hash columns describe both digest formats they carry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XPzApiE2BapNarJejheVXZH)_

Fixes #26603

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 设置审计表 `sys_setting_audit` 与平台孪生表 `sys_platform_setting_audit` 的 `old_hash` / `new_hash` 字段说明（TSDoc 与 `description`），改为同时写明两种摘要格式；四个语言的翻译包随之更新。只改说明文字。
- **为什么改:** 原说明写「SHA-256」，但机密值的行实际写的是带密钥的 `hmac-sha256:` 摘要。按说明核对审计行的运维或 AI 会把每条机密行判成格式错误，甚至拿机密的 SHA-256 去比对，这正是带密钥摘要要防的离线猜测。
- **风险与回滚:** 极低。不改写入内容、列类型、长度或列名，不碰 `packages/services/**`；回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看:** ① `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting-audit.object.ts`（两段说明）；② `sys-platform-setting-audit.object.ts`（孪生表对齐）；③ `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` 的两条重译。
- **两分钟验证:** `git grep -n "SHA-256 of the previous value" -- packages/platform-objects` 应无输出；`pnpm check:i18n` 应打印 `all bundles in sync`。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`sys_setting_audit`** (`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting-audit.object.ts`): the `old_hash` / `new_hash` TSDoc and `description` now state both formats the settings audit writer records:
  - a non-secret value: `sha256:` + hex SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (`settingAuditDigest`);
  - a secret value (`encrypted: true`): the crypto provider's keyed digest, `hmac-sha256:…`, never an unkeyed hash;
  - null as before (unset for `old_hash`, reset for `new_hash`), and null for a secret when no keyed digest is available;
  - the TSDoc adds that rows written before the `sha256:` digest may carry `fnv32:`, and that only same-prefix values compare.
- **`sys_platform_setting_audit`** (the global rung, same writer and row shape): the same two descriptions, plus TSDoc that points at the tenant table's format text.
- **Translation bundles:** `pnpm i18n:extract` (the generator the config's docstring and the root `package.json` name) refreshed the `en` leaves. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES leaves were re-translated in place (see Acceptance notes); a second `pnpm i18n:extract` leaves every bundle file, the source-hash tables included, byte-unchanged.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

Description text only: no column type, length or name changes, and nothing about what is written.

## Why

A secret row's `new_hash` has been the keyed digest since the keyed-digest work, and its `old_hash` is too since #26534 (PR #26600). The column metadata still said SHA-256. `/meta` serves these descriptions to Studio and agents, so a reader who checks a row against them is told a format secret rows never carry.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 96 passed (96), Tests 1361 passed (1361), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `eslint packages/platform-objects --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
- No behaviour moved, so no new test and no ablation: the change is field description text and its translations.

## Acceptance notes

- **Non-English leaves.** `os i18n extract --merge` only fills gaps, so it kept the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES translations of the old "SHA-256 of the … value" wording. They had no entry in the generated `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` tables (a translation, not a byte copy of the source), so they are legacy-trusted: measured after the regenerate and before the re-translation, `pnpm check:i18n` and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` both exited 0 while the three locales still served the SHA-256 text. No gate catches it. The bundle headers state the repo's rule for this case ("Re-translate it by hand when its source changes"; "Re-translate the leaf in the objects bundle and the next extract drops its entry by itself"), so the six leaves (`old_hash.help`, `new_hash.help` × three locales) were re-translated in place, leaf values only, and the second extract confirmed the structure is untouched.
- **`sys_platform_setting_audit` has no bundle entry.** The platform-objects extract config does not list that object, so its descriptions ship in English only. That was already true before this change, and it is not touched here.
- **Other prose that still says SHA-256** (not edited, outside this card's file surface): `packages/services/service-settings/src/crypto-adapter.ts:22` and `settings-audit-old-hash.test.ts:8-9` describe the declaration as SHA-256, and the pending `.changeset/26465-settings-audit-old-hash.md` does too. Each speaks of the non-secret digest, which is still SHA-256, so none is wrong; `packages/services/**` is outside this card's ruling.

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 53 commands; each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles "53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". 52 exited 0 on the first pass. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 (shallow clone: it could not read its pinned positive control `621a4876`); after `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it exited 0 ("48 cases pass").
- **i18n:** `pnpm check:i18n` "OK (10 package(s), all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)"; `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` "OK (11 bundle set(s), no new stale fills, 0 baselined)"; `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` "OK (14 config(s), 527 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)".
- **Declaration lines:** `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` (this body as the event) reads `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, "a non-protocol change at `patch`", and "moves no metadata-protocol baseline".
- **Acceptance grep:** `git grep -n "SHA-256 of the previous value" -- packages/platform-objects` exits 1 (no match).
- **Full build** (`pnpm build`, 116 tasks) under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0.
